description.value:
You weave a convincing illusion into the mind of a creature you can see within range. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or perceive — for the duration, and only it perceives it — a phantasmal creature, object, or phenomenon of your design, no larger than a 10-foot cube, complete with sound, temperature, and other sensory detail. Droids and constructs are unaffected.

As an action, the target may study the illusion with an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your force power save DC; success reveals it as false and ends the power. Until then, the target treats the hallucination as real, rationalizing any impossible outcomes of interacting with it — someone who falls through a phantom bridge, for instance, still believes the bridge existed and imagines some other cause for the fall.

The illusion can even hurt the target: on your turn, if it is a creature or hazard that could plausibly deal harm and the target is within its area or within 5 feet of it, it deals 1d6 psychic damage, which the target perceives as whatever damage type fits the illusion.

Cast with a 3rd-level slot or higher, the range increases by 20 feet, the illusion's maximum dimension increases by 5 feet, and you can affect one additional creature for every two slot levels above 2nd.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Dark Side Powers, Level 2
